items.source: Create a resource relative to the given Resource, also decoding the resource path for a UrlResource.
items.translation: 创建与给定的Resource相关的资源，并解码UrlResource的资源路径。

items.source: Note: this method assumes that leading, duplicate '/' or control characters (e.g. white space) have been trimmed so that the path starts predictably with a single '/' or does not have one.
items.translation: 注意： 此方法假定前导的重复 "/" 或控制字符（例如空白字符）已被修剪，因此路径可预测地以单个 "/" 开头，或者根本不带有一个。

items.source:
Normalize the given resource path replacing the following:
  • Backslash with forward slash.
  • Duplicate occurrences of slash with a single slash.
  • Any combination of leading slash and control characters (00-1F and 7F) with a single "/" or "". For example " / // foo/bar" becomes "/foo/bar".
items.translation:
规范化给定的资源路径，替换以下内容：
  • 将反斜杠替换为正斜杠。
  • 将重复出现的斜杠替换为单个斜杠。
  • 将任何前导斜杠和控制字符（00-1F 和 7F）的组合替换为单个"/"或""。例如，" / // foo/bar"变为"/foo/bar"。

items.source: Checks for invalid resource input paths rejecting the following: Paths that contain "WEB-INF" or "META-INF" Paths that contain "../" after a call to StringUtils.cleanPath(String).
items.translation: 检查无效的资源输入路径，拒绝以下路径： 包含 "WEB-INF" 或 "META-INF" 的路径。 在调用 StringUtils.cleanPath(String) 之后包含 "../" 的路径。

items.source: Whether the given input path is invalid as determined by isInvalidPath(String).
items.translation: 给定输入路径是否无效，由 isInvalidPath(String) 确定。

items.source: Whether the given input path is invalid as determined by isInvalidPath(String). The path is also decoded and the same checks are performed again.
items.translation: 给定输入路径是否无效，由 isInvalidPath(String) 确定。该路径还会被解码，并再次执行相同的检查。

items.source: Assert the given location is not null, and its path ends on slash.
items.translation: 断言给定的位置不为 null，且其路径以斜杠结尾。

items.source:
Check if the given static resource location path ends with a trailing
slash, and append it if necessary.
items.translation: 检查给定的静态资源位置路径是否以尾随斜杠结尾，如有必要则追加该斜杠。

items.source: Check whether the resource is under the given location.
items.translation: 检查资源是否位于给定位置。

items.source: Paths that contain "../" after a call to StringUtils.cleanPath(String).
items.translation: 在调用 StringUtils.cleanPath(String) 后包含 "../" 的路径。

items.source: Paths that represent a valid URL or would represent one after the leading slash is removed.
items.translation: 表示有效 URL或移除前导斜杠后将表示有效 URL 的路径。

items.source: true if the path is invalid, false otherwise

items.translation: 包含 "WEB-INF" 或 "META-INF" 的路径

items.source: Resource handling utility methods to share common logic between ResourceWebHandler and org.springframework.web.reactive.function.server.
items.translation: 用于在ResourceWebHandler和org.springframework.web.reactive.function.server之间共享通用逻辑的资源处理实用方法。
